dct_title_s: Hawaii Mauna Loa Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps and Interferograms, Nov 2022
dct_description_sm: # Hawaii Mauna Loa Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps and Interferograms, Nov 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps and interferograms for Hawaii Mauna Loa Volcano (Nov 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Hawaii, USA, Mauna Loa Volcano Eruption, 29 Nov 2022, v0.5** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Hawaii, USA, Mauna Loa Volcano Eruption, 29 Nov 2022, v0.5** - **EOS-RS Interferogram (unwrapped): Hawaii, USA, Mauna Loa Volcano Eruption, 2022/10/18-2022/11/29, v0.1** - **EOS-RS Interferogram (wrapped): Hawaii, USA, Mauna Loa Volcano Eruption, 2022/10/18-2022/11/29, v0.1** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Original data ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 Product - JAXA (2022).
